svg.title: Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert dynamics on the unit sphere: precession, overdamped geodesic, and renormalization
svg.desc: Numerically integrated LLG dynamics (alpha = 0.28, H_eff along +z): (a) 3D orthographic projection on S^2 comparing exact RK4 helical damped precession (s_prec = 1) with pure-damping geodesic relaxation (s_prec = 0, llg_overdamped) and orthogonal torque vectors in T_m S^2; (b) monotonic energy dissipation E(t)/E_0, axial relaxation m_z(t), and Larmor oscillation envelope m_x(t)^2; (c) discrete Runge-Kutta O(dt^(p+1)) radial drift and radial renormalization back onto S^2.
